correctness.rationale: Exactly 2*3^r orientations follow from forbidding the single triangle-cycle spoke pattern conditional on the spine direction. Every longer directed cycle would imply a forbidden triangle. The finite Boolean recurrence P(S,d)=OR_q(P(S_q0,d-1) AND P(S_q1,d-1)) is necessary and sufficient by tree induction, with exact cardinality pruning. Independently replayed full leaf-witness trees prove every lower bound for r=1..7. The separate topological elimination test checks all witness DAGs. Exact state searches prove failure of depth d+1 for every r=1..7, including 236276 memoized subproblems for the r=7 depth-12 exclusion. No infinite claim is inferred from finite checks.

originality.rationale: The new assertion is the exact online-shattering sequence of the natural complete-tripartite book family and the sharp first r=7 gap below the logarithmic orientation-count bound. Closest full primary texts supply orientation counts, classical forest/VC shattering, and Gray-code enumeration, but do not supply an adaptive tree-depth formula. Earlier published and accessible claims include the r=2 diamond and a general cactus criterion; neither determines the r=7 threshold. published-finding corpus searches over aliases and adaptive queries did not reveal a covering result. Priority outside indexed and inspected materials remains a risk.

value.rationale: Complete a natural seven-parameter exact online dimension sequence for acyclic orientations of the elementary book graphs K_{1,1,r}, with the precise first threshold where information-theoretic log2 concept count is unattainable. The sharp negative at seven pages is neither a routine derivation from VC rank nor obtainable from orientation counts; it exhibits a substantive, reproducible obstruction to balanced adaptive learning trees on an important bounded-treewidth graph family. The result does not claim a general formula for larger books.
